# One-line recipe

One ink line on warm paper, never lifted. The film is that line being drawn. The camera trails the nib. Scenes never cut; they morph into each other.

## Look
- The pen never lifts. The full film is a single point array, first touch to last frame. It may begin with the line already in motion.
- Everything is the line: figures, objects, distance, time. Exclude fills, shading, a second line weight and background art. The only other elements are paper and the pen's soft shadow.
- The viewer sees the drawing happen. The camera follows the nib with slight lag and anticipation.
- One accent colour, spent once, on a stretch that carries meaning. It stays visible in the final picture.
- Not a whiteboard explainer (no hand, marker or erasing). Not ink wash: no tonal range, no brush bloom. Not line-art animation built from cuts and many strokes.

## Surfaces
- Paper: the background token as a flat ground, plus one 512 px tile (soft mottling, long light and dark fibres, wrapped to repeat) painted once and moved with the camera. A light vignette from the second surface.
- Render ink as a filled polygon around the path; skip stroking. Width = chapter base width (2.8-3.7 units) x pen pressure `0.66 + 0.8·exp(−v/300)` (fast = thin, slow = fat) x fine noise (+-8 %).
- Bleed: a second, wider pass at 16 % opacity. Round dots where speed falls below 45 units/s read as pooling.
- Width floor on screen: use `max(zoom, 1.3)` so a pull-back keeps the line's weight.
- Tremble and dry gaps express time and fatigue. Perpendicular noise up to about 1.8 units, plus long-scale breaks in the ink, both growing through a chapter.
- Each stop leaves a teardrop blot. Point it at the nib; let the belly sag down while it spreads; add a darker tide line on the rim.
- Never draw the pen. Show a soft blurred shadow wedge from the nib at about 56° down-right and a 5 px contact dot.
- Paths: chapters are SVG path strings or generated point lists sampled every 2.5-4 units. Join them with cubic Hermite curves whose end tangents match. Weight time per point by `1 + 2.2·turn`, then smooth: corners get time and speed never jumps.

## Palette
- Paper `--latar`, ink `--teks`. On a dark brand the line turns light on dark; nothing else changes.
- The one accent stretch uses `--utama-di-latar` (a line on the background). A hand-written key word or number takes the same token.
- `--latar-2` shades the vignette. Leave `--aksen`, `--utama` as a fill, and `--teks-di-*` unused: this look has no fills or buttons.
- Nothing is fixed outside the tokens. Default values supply the warmth.

## Type
- `--font-judul`: Playfair Display italic 400 for the title and closing name. Script-like, written on, 108-120 px at 1920 wide.
- `--font-isi`: Caveat 700 for anything written beside the line: captions 58-66 px, big number 120 px, subtitle 52 px. Colour `--teks` (`--teks-redup` for a subtitle). No box. Give it a soft paper-coloured halo so a passing line never cuts through a letter.
- Write text on left to right using a clip, 0.8-1.4 s per line. Captions: centred, near y 930. Titles and numbers: on blank paper in the world, scrolling away with the camera.

## Timing
- The drawing is the choreography. Tween only the camera and the writing.
- Pen speed: 250-400 units/s for figures and details; 600-800 for a travelling line; up to 1,600 for a final sweep (viewed at small zoom, so it still looks calm).
- Slow down on the key stroke. Give corners time.
- A pen stop is a 0.4-0.6 s gap between chapters; the blot spreads over 1.2-1.6 s (`1 − (1 − u)^2.2`).
- Writing: `inset` clip from the left, linear, 0.9-1.4 s. Fade out in 0.4 s, `power1.in`. Hold the final picture still for 2 s or more.

## Camera
One continuous move with three parameters: centre, zoom, follow weight (composed at 0, locked on the nib at 1). The follow target is the nib's mean position from -0.55 to +0.4 s. Vertical follow is damped (x0.4) so a wave does not bob the frame. Smoothstep between keys; interpolate zoom in log space. Never cut.
- Composed frame, follow 0.2, zoom 1.1: a scene seen whole. Opening portrait; title beside a figure.
- Follow the nib, follow 1, zoom 0.95: travel, a thread of time. Journey; timeline; a relationship across distance.
- Macro on the nib, zoom 1.3-1.4: intimacy, the act of making. First touch; signature; a detail.
- Hold, then slow push-in: weight, a stop. A decision; a loss; a waiting moment.
- Continuous pull-back, zoom 1.2 to 0.5: it was one picture all along. A reveal; a map; the closing name.
- Lateral scroll with the line running ahead: horizon, graph. Road; heartbeat; race.

## Signature moves
- Pen never lifts: for anything that is one continuous thing. A letter crossing between two cities; a river from source to sea; a student's year; a delivery route.
- The line is time: tremble and dry gaps grow as the line tires. A long-distance wait; a marathon; a machine wearing out; a creator's hardest month.
- Transformation: each image ends with the stroke that begins the next. Sketch into product; seed into table; word into its object; a plane looping mid-line.
- Stopping is an event: the nib halts and a blot sags for 0.5-1.5 s. An incoming phone call; the pause before a signature; a minute of silence.
- Reverse-designed reveal: each vignette is secretly a piece of one large picture, shown in the last pull-back. A wedding couple's two cities and the arc joining them; brand milestones forming its mark; recipe steps forming the dish.
- Mirrored figure: the second figure is the first, mirrored and drawn backwards, so the line enters at its shoulder. Parent and child; teacher and student; before and after.

## Avoid
- Stray connectors look like wrinkles or beards. Plan the path as an Euler path: decide where each chapter enters and exits, draw each region once. Render the whole path and inspect it after every change.
- Lines that run too close braid together once width applies. Keep a gap of two line widths.
- A round blot looks like a mole. Use the sagging teardrop.
- Thin line at wide zoom: clamp the zoom used for width.
- As the camera travels, titles can run into the drawing. Place them on blank paper and check every frame of their window.
- Never repaint paper or redraw it per frame; move the single image.
- Hold the point count near 4,000. Beyond that the per-frame polygon fill becomes the slowest part of the film.

# One line: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.8, medium 3.2, long 4.4.

## hook

- en: the line is already running when the film opens, drawing the first figure; the camera rides the nib, a pen shadow trails it
- id: garis sudah berjalan sejak detik nol, menggambar sosok pertama; kamera menunggangi ujung pena, bayangan pena mengikuti

## problem

- en: the line leaves the figure and travels far as a wave that tires: wobble and dry breaks grow; the camera scrolls sideways with it
- id: garis meninggalkan sosoknya dan berjalan jauh jadi ombak yang lelah: gemetar dan jeda tinta kering makin banyak; kamera menggulir ke samping

## fact

- en: the line slows into a macro on one detail, written text appears on blank paper beside it, no cut
- id: garis melambat jadi jarak dekat pada satu detail, teks tulisan tangan muncul di kertas kosong di sebelahnya, tanpa potong

## step

- en: each step is the next stretch of the same line morphing into the next object; the nib never lifts, a short note is written beside it
- id: tiap langkah adalah lanjutan garis yang sama berubah jadi benda berikutnya; pena tak terangkat, catatan pendek ditulis di sampingnya

## compare

- en: two figures drawn at opposite ends of one line, the line between them carries the contrast; frame both in one wide composed shot
- id: dua sosok digambar di ujung-ujung satu garis, garis di antaranya membawa kontrasnya; keduanya dibingkai dalam satu bidikan lebar

## number

- en: the figure is written in hand lettering on blank paper, large, in the accent colour, while the line draws a small mark beside it
- id: angka ditulis tangan besar di kertas kosong, berwarna aksen, sementara garis menggambar tanda kecil di sampingnya

## proof

- en: the pen stops: a single ink blot spreads and sags from the nib for a second or two, then the line goes on
- id: pena berhenti: satu tetes tinta melebar dan menggantung dari ujung pena sedetik dua detik, lalu garis jalan lagi

## offer

- en: the line closes a shape in the accent colour around the offer, its words written inside in script
- id: garis menutup sebuah bentuk berwarna aksen di sekeliling penawaran, katanya ditulis di dalam dengan tulisan tangan

## cta

- en: continuous pull-back: the whole film turns out to be one drawing; name and contact written beneath it; held still 2.5 s
- id: kamera mundur tanpa putus: seluruh film ternyata satu gambar; nama dan kontak ditulis di bawahnya; diam 2,5 detik

## payoff

- en: the last stroke ends where the line began, the ink blot sags and settles; the title is written beneath; held still 2.5 s
- id: goresan terakhir berakhir di tempat garis mulai, tetes tinta menggantung dan diam; judul ditulis di bawahnya; diam 2,5 detik

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1920, height=1080" />
    <title>Satu garis</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Playfair Display"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; font-style: italic; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Caveat"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 700; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. */
      :root {
        --latar: #f4efe4; --latar-2: #e6dfce; --utama: #b3332b; --aksen: #44546a;
        --teks: #1d1a17; --teks-redup: #5a5249; --teks-di-utama: #fbf6ee; --teks-di-aksen: #f4efe4;
        --utama-di-latar: #b3332b; --aksen-di-latar: #44546a;
        --font-judul: "Playfair Display", "Noto Sans", serif; --font-isi: "Caveat", "Noto Sans", cursive;
      }
      * {margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
      html, body {width:1920px;height:1080px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--latar);}
      #root {position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:var(--latar);color:var(--teks);font-family:var(--font-isi);}
      .isi {position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:1920px;height:1080px;}
      img, canvas {position:absolute;left:0;top:0;display:block;}
      /* Dunia kertas: teks tertulis di kertas ikut kamera (translate + skala). */
      #dunia {position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:0;height:0;transform-origin:0 0;}
      .t {position:absolute;white-space:nowrap;line-height:1;text-shadow:0 0 8px var(--latar), 0 0 16px var(--latar);}
      #judul {left:960px;top:230px;font:italic 400 112px/1 var(--font-judul);}
      #sub {left:966px;top:380px;font:700 52px/1 var(--font-isi);color:var(--teks-redup);}
      #km {left:1470px;top:400px;font:700 120px/1 var(--font-isi);color:var(--utama-di-latar);}
      #vinyet {background:radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 80% at 50% 48%, transparent 62%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar-2) 55%, transparent));}
      #kertas {background:radial-gradient(ellipse 90% 90% at 50% 45%, color-mix(in oklab, var(--latar) 70%, white), var(--latar) 75%);}
      /* Bayangan pena: baji lembut dari ujung mata pena, tanpa menggambar penanya. */
      #pena {position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:560px;height:44px;margin-top:-22px;transform-origin:0 50%;filter:blur(3px);}
      #pena i {position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg, color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 30%, transparent), color-mix(in oklab, var(--teks) 13%, transparent) 60%, transparent);clip-path:polygon(0 47%, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 53%);}
      #nib {position:absolute;left:-2px;top:-2px;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teks);}
      /* Teks tulis tangan, ditulis dari kiri ke kanan (clip-path). */
      .cap {position:absolute;left:0;width:1920px;text-align:center;font:700 66px/1 var(--font-isi);text-shadow:0 0 10px var(--latar), 0 0 22px var(--latar);}
      .cap b {color:var(--utama-di-latar);font-weight:700;}
      .adegan {pointer-events:none;}
      #akhir {top:790px;font:italic 400 108px/1 var(--font-judul);}
      #kontak {top:925px;font-size:58px;color:var(--teks);}
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1920" data-height="1080" data-fps="30">
      <svg id="uji" width="0" height="0" style="position: absolute"></svg>
      <div class="isi" id="kertas"></div>
      <div id="dunia">
        <div class="t" id="judul">Garis Rindu</div>
        <div class="t" id="sub">kado satu garis untuk dua kota</div>
        <div class="t" id="km">1.842 km</div>
      </div>
      <canvas id="tinta" width="1920" height="1080"></canvas>
      <div id="pena"><i></i><div id="nib"></div></div>
      <div class="isi" id="vinyet"></div>
      <!-- Adegan 1, pembuka: garis sudah berjalan, menggambar Dina dan ponselnya; kamera mengikuti ujung pena. -->
      <div class="isi adegan" data-role="hook"><p class="cap" id="c1" style="top: 930px">Dina, di Ambon. Ponselnya menyala.</p></div>
      <!-- Adegan 2, masalah: garis meninggalkan Dina jadi ombak panjang yang makin gemetar; kamera menggulir ke samping. -->
      <div class="isi adegan" data-role="problem"><p class="cap" id="c2" style="top: 930px">Di antara mereka ada laut. Garis ikut lelah.</p></div>
      <!-- Adegan 3, fakta: garis tiba di Raka, pena berhenti, tinta menetes sekali. -->
      <div class="isi adegan" data-role="fact"><p class="cap" id="c3" style="top: 930px">Raka, di Bandung. Satu dering <b>masuk</b>.</p></div>
      <!-- Adegan 4, ajakan: garis merah membuat dua busur, kamera mundur, ternyata semuanya satu gambar. -->
      <div class="isi adegan" data-role="cta">
        <p class="cap" id="akhir">Garis Rindu</p>
        <p class="cap" id="kontak">Pesan kado satu garis lewat Chat 0812-3456-7890</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <script>
      const tl=gsap.timeline({paused:true});
      const $=(id)=>document.getElementById(id),{sin,cos,min,max,abs,hypot,atan2,PI,exp,floor,ceil,pow}=Math;
      const clamp=(v,a=0,b=1)=>min(b,max(a,v)),lerp=(a,b,t)=>a+(b-a)*t,ss=(t)=>{t=clamp(t);return t*t*(3-2*t);};
      const RNG=(seed)=>{let s=(seed*2654435761)>>>0||1;return()=>{s=(s+0x6d2b79f5)>>>0;let t=s;t=Math.imul(t^(t>>>15),t|1);t ^= t+Math.imul(t^(t>>>7),t|61);return((t^(t>>>14))>>>0)/4294967296;};};
      const css=(n)=>getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue(n).trim();
      const INK=css("--teks"),ACC=css("--utama-di-latar"),NS="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
      // Derau 1D bernilai (seed tetap), dipakai untuk tekanan, gemetar, dan jeda tinta kering.
      const NT=new Float64Array(512);
      (()=>{const r=RNG(7);for(let i=0;i<512;i++) NT[i]=r();})();
      const vnoise=(x)=>{const i=floor(x),f=x-i;return lerp(NT[i&511],NT[(i+1)&511],f*f*(3-2*f));};

      // Kertas: satu ubin 512 (serat, bintik, awan) digambar sekali, jadi <img>, lalu hanya digeser.
      function paper(){
        const tile=document.createElement("canvas");tile.width=tile.height=512;
        const g=tile.getContext("2d"),r=RNG(11);
        // Butir sangat halus (kontras di bawah 3%), tanpa awan dan serat.
        for(let i=0;i<2600;i++){
          const x=r()*512,y=r()*512,light=r()<0.5;
          g.fillStyle=light?`rgba(255,255,255,${0.015+r()*0.015})`:`rgba(70,56,40,${0.012+r()*0.012})`;
          g.fillRect(x,y,1,1);
        }
        const big=document.createElement("canvas");big.width=2560;big.height=2048;
        const bg=big.getContext("2d");
        for(let x=0;x<5;x++) for(let y=0;y<4;y++) bg.drawImage(tile,x*512,y*512);
        const im=new Image();Object.assign(im,{src:big["toDataURL"]("image/png")});
        im.style.willChange="transform";$("kertas").appendChild(im);return im;
      }
      const papel=paper();

      // Geometri: setiap bab adalah deretan titik; penghubung Hermite menjaga garis tetap menyambung.
      function sample(d,step=2.5){
        const p=document.createElementNS(NS,"path");p.setAttribute("d",d);$("uji").appendChild(p);
        const L=p.getTotalLength(),n=max(2,ceil(L/step)),o=[];
        for(let i=0;i<=n;i++){const q=p.getPointAtLength(L*i/n);o.push([q.x,q.y]);}
        return o;
      }
      const tan=(p,end)=>{const n=p.length,k=min(8,n-1),a=end?p[n-1-k]:p[0],b=end?p[n-1]:p[k],l=hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1])||1;return[(b[0]-a[0])/l,(b[1]-a[1])/l];};
      function conn(a,ta,b,tb){
        const D=hypot(b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]);if(D<1.2) return [];
        const h=D*0.42;
        return sample(`M${a[0]},${a[1]} C${a[0]+ta[0]*h},${a[1]+ta[1]*h} ${b[0]-tb[0]*h},${b[1]-tb[1]*h} ${b[0]},${b[1]}`).slice(1,-1);
      }
      // Dina: ponsel di tangannya, lalu wajah (dagu, hidung, dahi, rambut, sanggul, tengkuk) dan bahu yang jadi garis ombak.
      const PONSEL="M528 520L508 391Q506 383 498 384L452 392Q449 393 450 400L468 531Q470 540 478 538L521 531Q529 529 528 520";
      const WAJAH="M624 562C592 556 568 530 562 494L542 480L562 464C554 450 548 436 548 420C546 345 612 306 676 330C700 318 740 296 770 322C792 346 764 386 734 372C726 368 724 358 730 354C742 384 752 440 726 496C714 524 690 546 666 554C660 580 654 604 642 626C660 644 710 648 770 646";
      function dina(){const a=sample(PONSEL),b=sample(WAJAH);return a.concat(conn(a.at(-1),tan(a,1),b[0],tan(b,0)),b);}
      // Ombak: makin jauh makin tinggi dan gemetar; di tengah ada satu putaran loop (pesawat).
      function ombak(){
        const o=[],xl=2420,a=40,b=90;
        const wy=(x)=>{const u=(x-770)/2400,env=(18+78*u)*pow(sin(PI*u),0.55),near=ss((abs(x-xl)-110)/200);return 646+env*near*sin(u*PI*2*7);};
        for(let x=770;x<=3170;x+=4){
          if(abs(x-xl)<=a*PI){
            if(x<xl){for(let th=-PI;th<=PI;th+=0.04) o.push([xl+a*th-b*sin(th),646-b*(1+cos(th))]);}
            continue;
          }
          o.push([x,wy(x)]);
        }
        return o;
      }
      const HATI="M3450 380C3700 -120 3000 -420 1970 -60C940 -420 240 -120 490 380";
      const DINA=dina();
      // Raka: gambar Dina dicerminkan dan dibalik urutannya, jadi garis masuk dari bahunya di kiri.
      const RAKA=DINA.map((p)=>[3940-p[0],p[1]]).reverse();
      // t: jendela waktu bab; blot: tinta menetes saat pena berhenti di ujung bab.
      const SEGS=[
        {pts:DINA,w:3.3,t:[-1.0,3.4]},
        {pts:ombak(),w:2.8,t:[3.4,6.9],tr:1.8},
        {pts:RAKA,w:3.3,t:[6.9,8.4],blot:[8.4,1.2]},
        {pts:sample(HATI,3),w:3.7,t:[8.9,11.7],acc:1,blot:[11.7,1.6]}
      ];
      function build(){
        const X=[],Y=[],G=[],U=[];let prev=null;
        SEGS.forEach((sg,si)=>{
          let p=sg.pts;
          if(prev) p=conn(prev.at(-1),tan(prev,1),p[0],tan(p,0)).concat(p);
          const skip=prev&&hypot(p[0][0]-prev.at(-1)[0],p[0][1]-prev.at(-1)[1])<0.05?1:0;
          for(let i=skip;i<p.length;i++){X.push(p[i][0]);Y.push(p[i][1]);G.push(si);U.push(i/(p.length-1));}
          prev=p;
        });
        const N=X.length,S=new Float64Array(N),TURN=new Float64Array(N),T=new Float64Array(N),V=new Float64Array(N);
        for(let i=1;i<N;i++) S[i]=S[i-1]+hypot(X[i]-X[i-1],Y[i]-Y[i-1]);
        for(let i=6;i<N-6;i++){
          const d1=atan2(Y[i]-Y[i-6],X[i]-X[i-6]),d2=atan2(Y[i+6]-Y[i],X[i+6]-X[i]);
          let da=abs(d2-d1);if(da>PI) da=2*PI-da;TURN[i]=da;
        }
        // waktu: bagian yang menikung diberi waktu lebih (pena melambat), dihaluskan supaya laju tidak melompat
        SEGS.forEach((sg,si)=>{
          let i0=N,i1=0;for(let i=0;i<N;i++) if(G[i]===si){i0=min(i0,i);i1=max(i1,i);}
          const w=new Float64Array(i1-i0+1),R=14;
          for(let i=i0+1;i<=i1;i++) w[i-i0]=(S[i]-S[i-1])*(1+2.2*min(TURN[i]*3.2,3));
          const cum=new Float64Array(w.length);
          for(let j=1;j<w.length;j++){let a=0,c=0;for(let k=-R;k<=R;k++){const q=j+k;if(q>0&&q<w.length){const g=1-abs(k)/(R+1);a+=w[q]*g;c+=g;}}cum[j]=cum[j-1]+a/c;}
          for(let i=i0;i<=i1;i++) T[i]=lerp(sg.t[0],sg.t[1],cum[i-i0]/cum[cum.length-1]);
        });
        for(let i=1;i<N-1;i++){const dt=T[i+1]-T[i-1];V[i]=dt>1e-6?(S[i+1]-S[i-1])/dt:0;}
        V[0]=V[1];V[N-1]=V[N-2];
        // lebar = dasar bab x tekanan (cepat tipis, lambat tebal) x derau halus; gemetar tegak lurus di ombak
        const DX=X.slice(),DY=Y.slice(),W=new Float64Array(N),A=new Uint8Array(N),DRY=new Float64Array(N);
        for(let i=0;i<N;i++){
          const sg=SEGS[G[i]];
          W[i]=sg.w*(0.66+0.8*exp(-V[i]/300))*(1+0.16*(vnoise(S[i]/3.1+7)-0.5));A[i]=sg.acc?1:0;
          if(sg.tr&&i>0&&i<N-1){
            const u=U[i],dx=X[i+1]-X[i-1],dy=Y[i+1]-Y[i-1],l=hypot(dx,dy)||1;
            const m=sg.tr*ss(u*1.6)*((vnoise(S[i]/5.5)-0.5)*1.6+(vnoise(S[i]/2.3+40)-0.5)*0.7);
            DX[i]+=-dy/l*m;DY[i]+=dx/l*m;DRY[i]=max(0,u-0.45)*0.8;
          }
        }
        return {X:DX,Y:DY,S,T,V,W,A,DRY,N,G};
      }
      const P=build();
      const headAt=(t)=>{
        const{T,N}=P;if(t<=T[0]) return 0;if(t>=T[N-1]) return N-1;
        let lo=0,hi=N-1;while(lo<hi-1){const m=(lo+hi)>>1;if(T[m]<=t) lo=m;else hi=m;}
        const dt=T[hi]-T[lo];return lo+(dt>1e-9?(t-T[lo])/dt:1);
      };
